data.description:
## Story

As a release engineer running the Closure Checks migration, child-story `← Satisfies: "..."` annotations that reference criteria which have been moved to `## Closure Checks` are automatically rewritten to `← Validates Closure Check: "..."` — preventing orphaned annotation pointers after the migration.

## Done Definitions

- DD1: `migrate-closure-checks.sh` (from S5) updated with an annotation-rewrite step — after migrating a ticket's SC→Closure Checks split, the script scans all child stories for `← Satisfies:` annotations pointing to text that was moved to `## Closure Checks`, and rewrites them to `← Validates Closure Check:` form
- DD2: Post-migration: zero orphaned `← Satisfies:` annotations in any story that point to criterion text not present in `## Success Criteria` (verified by audit script pass with 0 annotation-mismatch warnings)
- DD3: Test: a story body containing `← Satisfies: "criterion text"` where "criterion text" was moved to the parent epic's `## Closure Checks` produces `← Validates Closure Check: "criterion text"` after migration

← Satisfies: "SC (adversarial F6): child-story annotation pointers updated during migration"

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked — agents proceed unless a significant assumption is required that could send implementation in the wrong direction. All assumptions made without escalating are documented.
data.title: Child-story Satisfies annotations are updated during migration so they point to post-migration SC locations
